text: Abraham had pleaded for Sodom. In Genesis 22 the three days of travel are a kind of suspended sentence: outwardly nothing happens, and in significance everything happens. Faith, in this story, takes the form of a structured relation or arrangement. Obedience stands beside horror, and neither is suffered to prevail over the other. The servants, the wood, the knife, and the fire are each named with care; and the instruments of the act are present before the act itself is done.
